name: io.github.Dongwu259/photo-s
title: PhotoS
description: Batch photo processing toolbox for AI agents and humans: compress to target size, convert formats (JPEG/PNG/WebP/TIFF/HEIC/AVIF/RAW), read & write EXIF, template rename, perceptual dedup, exposure/sharpness culling, checksum manifests, contact sheets, HTML galleries, folder watch automation and benchmarks.
